meaning: Model_1's tilt angles are no longer literal numbers here; they are read from the shared Θ_STAGES/Θ_ONSETS schedule in ../Protocol.jl, so M1 and Model_3_celia use one protocol. The comment records that M1 previously had θ_dynamic_1 = 0.0 against M3's 70°, making M1's angle protocol a no-op.

could_move.what: M1 postural runs now see a non-zero first-stage angle, so gravity-driven pressure shifts appear where the run was effectively flat.
Postural deck output and the M1-vs-M4 comparison change if produced under the old no-op angle.
The h-sweep postural decks now sweep over a protocol that actually tilts.
Fitted parameters may shift for any fit run on postural data, since the forcing changed.

expectation: M1 postural runs should show a real tilt response instead of a flat one. Size unknown from this context; the 70° figure is quoted in the comment, not verified here.

check.why: Replots one postural deck without refitting, so you can see whether M1 now tilts and whether the stored figure still matches.
